personality_one_liner: A dark, data-forward, clinical lab instrument for realistic physique transformation.

typography.guidelines: Big, thin numerals (weight 300/400) for stats (weight, kcal, streak). Small uppercase letter-spaced labels (weight 500, size sm) for metadata to mimic an instrument readout. Body text regular weight, generous line height.

spacing.rule: Strict 8-pt grid system. Generous padding around charts and data visualizations. Avoid cramping data points.

do's: Use dark gradient scrims over full-bleed photo cards (transparent at top to >=70% surface/surfaceSecondary at bottom).
Use subtle blur on floating action or pinned filter chips over scrolling charts.
Blur the user's base photo when privacy toggle is active.
dont's: Do not use heavy glassmorphism on data cards; clarity beats aesthetics.
No blur behind primary text/stats readout.

screens.name: Welcome / Consent
screens.purpose: Age gate and clear, warm consent collection.
screens.layout: Minimalist center-aligned content. Big thin typography for title. Clear plain-language terms. Bottom sticky primary CTA.

screens.name: Onboarding Wizard
screens.purpose: 5-step wizard capturing vitals, activity, limitations, and timeline.

states.error: Validation inline text in warning color.

screens.layout: Top progress bar. Single column form. Big interactive sliders for timeline (8-52 weeks). Bottom sticky Continue button.

screens.name: Guided Photo Capture
screens.purpose: Camera view with silhouette overlay to capture base physique.
screens.layout: Full screen camera. Central silhouette outline. Large circular capture button at bottom. Safe area clearance.

screens.name: Generating Status
screens.purpose: Background job polling screen while AI processes targets.

states.loading: Animated skeleton loaders representing the UI being built (No spinners!).

screens.layout: Data-forward loading screen. 'Building target matrix...' text. Skeleton charts drawing in.

screens.name: Your Realistic Targets
screens.layout: Horizontal snap carousel of full-bleed image cards. Underneath: weight/body-fat estimates, 'what it takes' text, and engine reasoning card. Sticky 'Choose Target' CTA.

screens.name: Plan Overview
screens.purpose: Weekly calendar, meals, workouts, and recovery protocol.
screens.layout: Top weekly horizontal calendar. Full-bleed photo cards with dark gradient scrims for meal/workout sections. Left-aligned titles. Medical disclaimer at the very bottom.

screens.name: Today
screens.purpose: Home tab for daily checkboxes, quick logging, and stats.
screens.layout: Top: Big thin numerals for streak/next milestone. Middle: Flat list rows with hairline dividers for meals/workouts. Trailing status icons (check/rescheduled). Bottom: AI coach nudge card.

screens.name: Coach
screens.layout: Standard chat interface but styled like a clinical log. Messages use surfaceSecondary. Bottom input field. Timestamp metadata in small uppercase.

screens.name: Progress
screens.purpose: Side-by-side comparison viewer and weight charts.

states.empty: Log more data to see trends.

screens.layout: Top half: Image comparison viewer with draggable divider (Reanimated/Gesture Handler). Bottom half: Thin gradient line charts (Weight/Body Fat/Energy) on a dark grid with pill-shaped filters underneath.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage units, notifications, exports, and account deletion.
screens.layout: Simple flat list with hairline dividers. Sections for preferences, data, and destructive actions.

meal_prep_card.alt: Healthy meal prep in neutral background

instructions_to_main_agent: Use a StyleSheet-based theming approach (design token object) for styling. Do not use NativeWind.

Implement the 'lab instrument' aesthetic strictly: use background #0E0F12, surface #17181C, and borders #26272C. Use thin typography (Inter) with big numerals for stats and small, uppercase, letter-spaced labels for metadata.
Charts MUST be thin gradient line charts (Teal #2DD4BF -> Blue #3B82F6 -> Violet #8B5CF6) with small circular markers on a dark grid, resembling clinical monitoring dashboards.

Use full-bleed image cards for plan sections (meals, workouts). These MUST have a vertical gradient scrim layered between the image and text (transparent top -> >=70% surfaceInverse bottom) to ensure readability.
List rows must be flat with hairline (border 1px max) dividers and trailing status text (e.g., neutral gray 'rescheduled' instead of a red X for missed items).
Micro-interactions are mandatory: Checkbox completion requires a small haptic + 200ms ease animation. Charts must draw in on mount.
Do NOT use spinners for loading states. Use skeleton loaders that map to the actual UI shape.
The Progress screen requires a custom side-by-side image comparison viewer with a draggable divider using react-native-reanimated and react-native-gesture-handler.
Ensure high accessibility: minimum AA contrast, dynamic type support, minimum 44x44 tap targets.
Include a short medical disclaimer on every plan screen.
Ensure 'Feather' thin line icons are used globally. Use the accent tint for active tab states.
